name: Pipeline Review
tagline: A sales veteran's read of any CRM pipeline export — plus the warm intros your own network can offer each open deal.
who: Investors, advisors, and sales leaders who review someone else's pipeline and want fast, opinionated feedback — and to know exactly where their network opens doors.
how: Drop in a pipeline CSV or Excel export: your agent sizes the pipeline, flags stalled, slipping, and single-threaded deals by name, and delivers a sheet plus a short written read. Add a LinkedIn data export and it cross-references your connections against the target accounts and ranks the two or three intros worth making this week.
